Summer 2026 RobuxFest Main Prize
We aren’t just giving away a simple pre-built with top of the line specs, but a whole setup with a desk, a gaming chair, keyboard, mouse, headset and a monitor! We pick the best possible models, things that we use ourselves (one of our employees will push Herman Miller chairs to the end). The main attraction, of course, is a custom-designed case made in collaboration with HyperPC, perfectly fitting the client’s tastes.
Ruslan from Moscow was a winner in our very first, FunPay-themed Lootery. As a fan of Path of Exile (a game that is central to our trading platform), he received a custom, Orb-decorated PC.
Vika from Stavropol was one of our winners during the New Year’s Eve Lootery of 2025. She provides World of Warcraft services on FunPay and is a huge fan of Ysera. Her PC was designed with the Green Dragonflight and The Emerald Dream themes in mind: with crystals, vines and a Ysera figurine.

Technical
specs

  • Designer case with custom water cooling loop.
  • Top-tier GPU: currently ASUS GeForce RTX 5090 ROG Astral BTF.
  • Best gaming CPU: currently AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D.
  • Lots of RAM: 64GB of Kingston FURY Renegade RGB.
  • Massive dual NVMe storage: 4TB Samsung 990 PRO as primary drive and 2TB Samsung 9100 PRO as secondary.
  • Highest spec motherboard: ASUS ROG CROSSHAIR X870E HERO BTF.
  • OLED monitor, a headset, keyboard, mouse, mic — all the necessary peripherals a gaming PC like this deserves.
  • Specialized desk that can withstand all the weight as well as an ergonomic gaming chair from Herman Miller.
  • This list is not set in stone: we may include something better or throw in some game codes. No cliches when it comes to the grand prize and we always cater to the winner’s wishes and preferences.
